final_message:
I implemented `convert` in `src/convert.ts` and `parseQuantity` / `convertText` in `src/quantity.ts`, following the README. All 12 tests pass with `npm test`.

Beyond the tests, I checked a few edge cases by hand: `convertText("1 m", "cm", 0)` gives `"100 cm"`, a rounded zero prints as `"0 km"` (never `-0`), and `-459.67 F` converts to exactly `0 K`.
